timecapsule.mdd: I cannot read it until that day either. Really.
timecapsule.ph.letter: To me, one year from now. I hope this worry looks small by then.
timecapsule.status.idle: Write the letter and pick when it opens — you get a link nobody can open before then.
timecapsule.note: The key only comes from a public randomness beacon on that day — not the writer, not the reader, not this site can open it earlier. Changing your computer clock will not help. In exchange, that public beacon has to keep running.
timecapsule.err.tooSoon: The opening time has to be more than a minute from now.
timecapsule.status.sealing: Locking… fetching that day’s slot from the public beacon.
timecapsule.hint.url: This link *is* the letter — lose it and the letter is gone. Nothing is kept on our side.
timecapsule.say.sealed: Locked. Nobody can open it until that day.
timecapsule.say.notYet: Not time yet. Come back to this link then.
timecapsule.err.open: Either it is not time yet, or the link is incomplete. ({msg})
